articles.title: Solana gets its first Strategy STRC product through Solstice Finance
articles.snippet: The Solana vault splits income from Strategy’s preferred stock into a lower-risk senior token and a higher-risk junior token.

articles.title: Bitcoin volatility is in meltdown, but downside protection still commands a premium
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s BVIV volatility index hit the lowest level since 2025 as option demand collapsed. Still, overwriting surged and downside protection stayed pricey.

articles.title: Bitcoin Red Team founder turns to Chinese AI: ‘It absolutely guts me’
articles.snippet: Bitcoin Red Team has now found 1,288 critical and high-level vulnerabilities in the Bitcoin ecosystem as of Saturday.

articles.title: BIP-110 Bitcoin branch stalls after two blocks as gap widens
articles.snippet: The enforcing fork remains stuck at Bitcoin’s full mining difficulty as mandatory signaling proceeds with little hashpower support.

articles.title: US Treasury’s OFAC sanctions 2 Iran-linked crypto exchanges
articles.snippet: The US government sanctioned an individual and two crypto exchanges it said facilitated money laundering for a combined $5 million in digital assets linked to Iran.
